notes: Elements #78–#82 (student filters in Asignación screen) are referenced collectively as 'filtros para filtrar alumnos' without individual IDs. Behavioral coverage is present and sufficient.
Element #97 (delete icon in Rúbrica item form) is referenced implicitly via the general delete-row behavior described for rubric table rows. Sufficient.

boceto-elements.md at html-source-prototype/ is outdated (shows old pre-renumbering IDs). Source of truth used: boceto-metadata.json (122 elements, no conflicts, confirmed against HTML data-element-id attributes).

All data_needs declared in ui-spec.json have corresponding tables in schema.sql: legislation, cycle, module, teacher, teacher_module, student, student_module, project, project_student, rubric, rubric_item, rubric_level, correction, correction_item.

Account locking after 3 failed attempts: resolved by adding teacher.failed_login_attempts (INT DEFAULT 0) and teacher.account_locked (BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE). Admin can query locked accounts and reset account_locked via the Profesorado screen.

Cascade filter #27 (module creation — 'shows only cycles that belong to the selected legislation'): cycle has no legislation_id in schema (intentional design decision — legislation is carried by module, not cycle). The selector will display all cycles; cascade narrows year via legislation.start_year. Accepted design consequence.
Max 3 students per project: enforced at application layer. No DB COUNT constraint needed.
Max 10 rubric points: enforced at application layer. No DB CHECK on rubric sum needed.
